name: ai-cyber-appetitebind
description: Appetitebind — AI risk-appetite RMF OS (OpenAPI-first DDD)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @appetitebind/core build && pnpm --filter @appetitebind/services build && pnpm --filter @appetitebind/adapters build && pnpm --filter @appetitebind/api-server build
scripts.codegen:core: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --layers core --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:identity: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:webapp: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain usecases --domain appetite --domain fairness --domain assessments --domain controls --domain monitoring --domain predictions --domain governance --layers webapp --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build --no-fail-fast --no-clean
